about: Per-episode body_names (the order the episode's observation.body_pose columns were stacked in) and object_body for the 5,000 episodes of the qvla-v1 pretraining corpus, read from each episode's own recording trace. build_awr_weights --binding names reads them to find the object Eq. (3)'s hand distance is measured to; approach_aware.chunk.awr_weights in SIGNALS.lock was built with exactly these. An episode's body_names is robot_prefix + scenes[i] for its entry [i, object_body]; the episode_names module reads and digests this file.
